subject: general
question: Sohan is facing north-west. He turns 90° clockwise, then 360° anticlockwise and then 90° clockwise. In which direction is Sohan facing now?
solution:
Drawing the figure as per given information:

 
• Sohan is facing north-west. 
 
• He turns 90° clockwise, 
 
• Then 360° anticlockwise (Means the same place and direction)
 
• And then 90° clockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/098aa816986543da47a4979a327080fd1043924d9b6d39b805636873acb5e839.png] 

Here, Sohan is facing the 'South-East' direction now.

Hence,** 'Option 3'** is the correct answer.
